title: Joint Chiefs staff colonel confirms a UFO cover-up
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Joint Chiefs staff colonel confirms a UFO cover-up, about 1980s (Reagan administration) at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I asked this fellow, I said, "Is there really a UFO cover-up?" And he said, "Yes." He said, "That's all I can tell you." He says, "The rest you can figure out for yourself."

plain: A scientist, John Brandenburg, says that in the 1980s, while Ronald Reagan was president, he met a colonel on the staff of the Joint Chiefs, the council of the top US military leaders, in Washington. Brandenburg says he asked him if there really was a UFO cover-up, and the colonel said "Yes," adding that this was all he could say and the rest Brandenburg could figure out himself. He tells it as a rare confirmation from inside the military that something is being hidden.
